en: Ugh, gross!

jp: 半分腐ってるじゃねーか！！
en: What the hell are these things!? Their insides are half rotted away!!

jp: 動く、悪魔の死体・・・？
en: Walking demon corpses...?

jp: 甘くてすっぱい匂い・・
en: ...Ugh. A sweet, sour smell...
...That's it. I'm seriously gonna puke.
What on earth is going on?

jp: 古に語られる悪魔の中に
死体を操る悪魔の名前を
en: Among the demons of ancient lore, I have heard of one who commanded the dead.
The bearer of the Evil Eye that commands the dead. If I recall...
One of the Ancient Archdemons the angels defeated in the 555-Day War of Lamentation.
Pasca of the Evil Eye, who commands the dead.

jp: 悪魔の死体を操れる者は、
パスカをおいて他にはない
en: Yes... Pasca. None but Pasca could command the corpses of demons.

jp: その＜パスカ＞って悪魔が
en: Then this Pasca demon was the one moving the corpses!?

jp: いや、それはありえない
悪魔パスカは天使軍に破れ、
en: No, that is impossible. The demon Pasca lost to the angel host and was executed.

jp: それじゃあ、いったい・・・
en: Then what on earth...

jp: 自らの魔力と魂を刻んだ指輪を
en: I recall the Ancient Archdemons each bore a ring etched with their power and soul.

jp: 魔力と魂を刻んだ指輪？
en: A ring etched with their power and soul?

jp: ＜ペインリング＞と呼ばれている
en: Yes. Those rings are called Pain Rings.

jp: アラギと言っていたか・・・
en: Aragi, was it...

jp: あの男が持っていた指輪、
パスカの魔力が刻み込まれた
＜ペインリング＞ではないのか？
en: The ring that man carried: was it not the Pain Ring etched with Pasca's power?

jp: どうやら、図星のようだな
en: It seems I have hit the mark.
You!!

jp: 悟られたくないのなら
言い当てられたとしても
感情を荒立てるべきではないな
en: If you did not want it known, you should not bristle when someone guesses right.

jp: 肯定しているのと同じだ
en: That is as good as admitting it.
Who are you!?

jp: それ以上でも、それ以下でもない
en: I am Cain's guardian. Nothing more, nothing less.

jp: なぁ、取り込み中悪いけれど
話が長くなるんだったら
ここを出てからにしようぜ
en: Hey, sorry to butt in, but if this is gonna be a long talk, let's have it outside.

jp: アタシ達をはぐらかすつもり？
en: Is that your way of dodging us?

jp: あんたには聞きたいことがあるわ
en: Grey angel. I have questions for you.
That hardly looks like the manner of one making a request.

jp: ええ、大人しく答えるなら
en: Right. Answer nicely and I won't kill you.

jp: あんたは一体何を知っているの？
en: Answer me. What exactly do you know?

jp: 何か、繋がりのようなものを
en: Do you not sense some kind of connection?
Connection?

jp: そのアラギがさらおうとした
en: The girl Aragi tried to abduct: Matia.

jp: マティアを連れ去った
en: The six-winged angel who took Matia away called her an Incest.
So what?

jp: 私は何かを知っている
en: It is not that I know anything.

jp: 全ては推測の域だ・・
だが、全てが全て無関係とは
言い切れないと思わないか？
en: It is all conjecture... But can you say for certain none of it is connected?

jp: 私は＜インセスト＞という言葉に
何か引っかかるようなものを
en: Something about the word Incest catches at me.

jp: ただ、それだけのことだ
en: That is all there is to it.

jp: 我々も聞かせてもらおう
en: Now let us hear it from you.

jp: 何故、アラギはマティアを・・・
いや、＜インセスト＞を狙った？
en: Why did Aragi go after Matia... no, after the Incest?

jp: 一体、天使や悪魔に狙われる
en: What is this Incest that angels and demons alike hunt?

jp: 特殊な力を持つ人間のことらしい
けれど、それ以上は知らないわ
en: An Incest is a human with some special power, they say. I don't know more than that.

jp: 翼の付け根にあたる部分に
赤いアザがあるはずよ
en: Only that they bear a red mark where, on us, the wings take root.
A mark?

jp: ＜神の見えざる手＞とも呼ばれる
en: Yes. A red mark called the Mark of the Sinner, or the Invisible Hand of God...

jp: それで、マティアをさらって
アラギは一体何をするつもり
en: So what was Aragi planning to do, kidnapping Matia?

jp: こっちが知りたいくらいよ！
en: Aragi's goal? I'd like to know that myself!

jp: でも、六翼の天使にやられて
あいつはもういない・・・
en: But the six-winged angel got him. He's gone now...
Huh!?

jp: ・・・そう、死んだはずだった
あいつが死ぬところを
en: ...Yes, he should be dead. We watched him die.

jp: でも、あいつの死体は消えた
持っていたはずの、パスカの
ペインリングと一緒にね・・・
en: But his body vanished. Along with Pasca's Pain Ring, which should've been on him...

jp: そこに隠れているのは
en: Come out, Aragi! I know you're hiding there!!

jp: 完全に気配を消したつもり
en: Well, well... And here I thought I'd hidden my presence completely.

jp: パスカどもは死んだか・・・
en: So the Pascas are dead...

jp: 最初から死んでいたか
en: No, they were dead from the start, weren't they.
Kukuku...
Aragi!!

jp: つくづく＜規格外＞な野郎だな
まさかパスカのペインリングの
存在まで知ってるとは・・・
en: You really are an irregular bastard. Fancy you knowing about Pasca's Pain Ring...

jp: 未だに存在しているとは
思ってもみなかったがな
en: I never imagined there was still someone alive who could wield it.

jp: いちいち鼻につくやつだな
en: ......Hmph. Every word out of you grates.
I don't like it...

jp: あんたが奪ったペインリング
今日こそ返して貰うよ！！
en: Aragi... Today you give back the Pain Ring you stole!!
Yes. Along with your traitor's head!!

jp: ルカにザイオン・・・
あいつの性能をためすには
丁度良いオモチャだな
en: Luca and Zion... Just the toys to test out what he can do.

jp: 何をごちゃごちゃと・・・
en: What are you muttering about...

jp: 余裕みせてる暇はないよ！！
en: No time to play it cool!!
What!?

jp: どけよ、死に損ないに用はない
en: Out of my way. I've no use for a half-dead wretch.

jp: ルカの攻撃を受け止めちまった！
en: Who the hell is that guy? He just blocked Luca's attack!
And that face... He looks like Cain?
That ring!?
So you noticed...

jp: 何故、メフィストの指輪を
en: Why do you have Mephisto's ring!?

jp: 持つべきものではない！！
en: That is not yours to hold!!

jp: いや・・違うな、これは元々
オレが持つはずだった指輪だ
en: No... wrong. This ring was meant to be mine from the start.
Still haven't figured it out, Johannes?
How do you know my name...

jp: 忘れているのはお前の方だ
en: You're the one who's forgotten, Johannes.
And Cain.
Ngh!!

jp: 今、翼に痛みを感じただろう？
en: You felt a pain in your wings just now, didn't you?
Wh-what did you do?

jp: オレは何もしていない
お前が勝手に痛いと感じただけだ
en: I did nothing. You simply felt pain all on your own.

jp: ガキが調子にのるんじゃないよ！
en: ...Why you! Don't get cocky, brat!

jp: 悪魔に本気でかなうと
en: Hah! Did you really think you could match a demon?
...You're noisy.
A black-wing!?
...Die.
Look out! Luca!!!
Gaaah!!
....Tch. I meant to kill her. You're in the way.
That's enough.

jp: 相変わらず健気だなぁ
en: Kukuku... Loyal as ever, aren't you, Zion!
Silence, traitor.

jp: なかなかの腕じゃないか
en: Still, not bad at all, Abel.

jp: いい拾い物をしたみたいだな
en: Kukuku... Seems I picked up a better find than I expected.
...Abel, did you say?
It's been a while, Johannes.

jp: こんな形でお前と会うことに
なるとは思ってもみなかったよ
en: And Cain... I never imagined I'd be meeting you like this.
Who... who are you...

jp: ああ、よく知っているよ
ヨハネもマティアも・・・
en: Oh, I know all about you. Johannes, Matia... and you, too.
So die, Cain.
You're an eyesore.

jp: 突然そんなこと言われても
ボクが何をしたというの！？
en: An eyesore...? You can't just say that out of nowhere. What did I ever do!?

jp: お前の存在そのものが
否定されるべきものなんだよ！
en: Your very existence is something that should be denied!

jp: 全てがオレを不快にさせる
en: That face, that voice... everything about you disgusts me.

jp: そんなの無茶苦茶だよ
en: That's... that's insane.

jp: 絶望の中でオレに殺されるんだ
en: You don't need to understand. You'll lose everything, and die by my hand in despair.

jp: 絶望って、いったい・・・
en: Despair... what do you mean...

jp: マティアを、殺してやるよ
en: I'm going to kill Matia.

jp: まずはここにいるお前の仲間達
en: Then again... maybe I'll start with your friends here?
I won't let you!!

jp: 己の無力さを噛みしめろ
en: Taste your own helplessness, Cain.

jp: 死ぬべきなのは、お前だ！！
en: You're the one who should die!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
